scientific_integrity: Exact analytical proof with independently evaluated numerical line-hit quadrature as corroboration; historical novelty is qualified by specified inspected sources and unexamined full texts; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Requires known cyclic side labels and motion-invariant unoriented random lines; shape recovered only up to similarity and reflection.
Stability is local away from vanishing sides and flat or zero interior angles.
No finite-sample error guarantee, no assertion for unlabeled chord distributions or nonpolygonal convex bodies.
title: Local Crofton tomography and feasibility of convex polygons
